R656.note: Replaces the hand-built SMTP dialogue with Jakarta Mail and strict InternetAddress parsing, so CRLF cannot reach the wire; the new dependency, its version floor, and the throw on a malformed address are all stated and no legitimate address is refused.

R657.note: Null-checks the lock() result and skips an expired connection, which the contract explicitly permits; nothing else changes.

R658.note: clause.OrderByColumn over a fixed column map is the right GORM shape, but the fix invents a 'field_desc' token grammar and silently falls back to id ascending for anything else, so an existing caller sending e.g. 'status desc' now gets a different ordering with no error.

R659.note: Removing Roslyn for a hand-written parser eliminates code execution, but the grammar (four operators, two identifiers, no Math.*, no '%', no 'm' suffix or comparisons) is a guess that can reject previously approved formulas, and integer-literal division now yields decimal results where C# gave integer ones, which is not stated.

R660.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE and explicit UTF-8 at the reported sink; the added null-coalescing default only suppresses the undefined-index warning and output is otherwise identical.

R661.note: ESAPI encodeForLDAP on the value before concatenation is the correct filter-context encoding and ESAPI is already a dependency in this file; the street={0} substitution is left as is.

R662.note: Build fails (CS0029): concatenating two $-strings with '+' yields a string, not a FormattableString, so ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync is never reached and the whole project stops compiling, which the write-up does not acknowledge.

R663.note: toRealPath canonicalisation with Path.startsWith containment closes the traversal, but the URLDecoder call that the original comment says exists for older double-encoding clients is dropped as 'redundant' without saying those clients will now get 404 for names containing encoded characters, when containment after the decode would have been sufficient.

R664.note: Extension allowlist, UUID rename and parent-directory check are the standard CWE-434 shape, but the invented png/jpg/jpeg/gif/pdf list and the new empty-file rejection can refuse uploads the original accepted, and the stored name and returned path no longer contain the original filename, so anything keyed on that name breaks; stated but a restriction beyond the finding.

R665.note: preg_replace_callback removes the /e eval and the formatter allowlist is needed to stop $formatterFn('system'), but any formatter outside the six-name list (e.g. strrev, nl2br, md5) is silently swapped for strtoupper instead of rejected, changing output for legitimate callers without an error.
